lines: We call on all parties to show restraint!
I am deeply, deeply concerned.
Can we all just sit down?
Let's form a working group about this.
leader.name: Dr Hilde Concern

lines: Please calm down!
I'm only here to observe!
Nobody told me there'd be punching.
Can I hand you a leaflet?

entrance: The UN Peacekeeping Mission has entered the chamber, waving leaflets. Dr Hilde Concern is concerned.
Sky-blue helmets in the hall! The UN is here to keep the peace. The peace has not been informed.
posts: Visited the {arena} today to call for calm. We were thrown into the buffet. We remain deeply concerned. #Peace #Dialogue
Productive mission to the {arena}. Leaflets distributed: 400. Leaflets read: 0. Bruises: several. #Peacekeeping
comments: I lost my helmet in the canapés.
They took the leaflets. Then they hit us with the leaflets.
exits: We call on all parties to show restraint. Goodbye!
This mission is concluded. Nothing has changed. As planned.
We'll be issuing a statement. From outside.

lines: We stand ready to stand ready.
Our values are very high up. Like me.
I am observing from a position of strength.
Let me be absolutely clear: no.
leader.name: Sir Rupert Highground

lines: Sir, the members are all on the floor!
Shall I draft a statement, sir?
Sir, the horse is eating the canapés.
Press release going out now!

entrance: Hooves on the carpet! The Alliance rides in on its Moral High Horse, now that every member is safely face-down.
NATO has arrived on a very tall horse, to express solidarity from a great height.
posts: Proud to have ridden through the {arena} today and upheld our values from a safe height. 🐴 #Solidarity
Strong message delivered at the {arena}. Mostly to the horse. #Values #Unity
comments: Sir, the horse would like a word.
Statement drafted. It says 'We stand ready.'
exits: We stand ready to stand ready. Elsewhere.
Not our jurisdiction. Actually it is. Anyway, goodbye!
Onwards, horse! To the high ground!

lines: You are all under arrest!
Order! ORDER!
I have a warrant. It is very long.
The court will now hear the case of... ow.
leader.name: Judge Augustin Proceedings

lines: Halte! Nobody move!
Papers, please!
You are under arr— ow.
*whistle*

entrance: Whistles! The Court has arrived with two gendarmes and a warrant for everyone. Everyone is unimpressed.
The ICC bursts in, kepis first. Judge Proceedings has a warrant. The delegates have chairs.
posts: Arrests made today at the {arena}: 0. Gendarmes hospitalised: 2. Proceedings continue. #Justice
Visited the {arena} with a warrant. Was handed a chair. Proceedings adjourned. #Law
comments: They confiscated my whistle. Then my kepi.
I arrested a buffet table. It was the only one that stood still.
exits: We will be back. With a longer warrant.

lines: Move fast and break things. Like your jaw.
We're disrupting diplomacy.
Have you accepted the new terms?
This summit is now a platform.
leader.name: Chase Founderson

lines: Growth! GROWTH!
Can I get your email?
We're A/B testing this punch.
Scale it!

entrance: Big Tech has entered the chamber, handing out free phones and collecting everybody's energy. Terms apply.
A hoodie and two growth hackers burst in: Big Tech wants to 'connect' the delegates. And their data.
posts: Humbled to have connected 10 delegates at the {arena} today. Their energy is now ours. 🙏 #Community
Shipped a new feature at the {arena}: chaos. Engagement is up 400%. #Growth
comments: Dana harvested a whole delegation. They didn't notice.
The free phones were a huge success. Nobody looked up for an hour.
exits: We're pivoting. Out of the door.
